subject: The 80% claim, and a question of approval
alt: Satish Acharya's cartoon: on a white ground, a balding leader in saffron robes with a saffron stole and a red tilak on his forehead laughs happily, his right fist raised. Above his head a speech bubble reads in large black letters: WE'LL WIN 80% VOTES! Behind him on the right stands a man in glasses and a grey kurta, his hand cupped to his mouth, whispering; his bubble reads: DID YOU TAKE GYANUSI'S APPROVAL? At the lower left is a microphone with a red square badge. At the lower left, the cartoonist's signature: SATISH ACHARYA.
chutki: The leader in saffron raises his fist and declares: we will win 80% of the votes! Behind him, an aide covers his mouth and asks in his ear: did you take Gyanusi's approval?

The cartoon's arrow is aimed at a claim that settles the result before a single vote is cast. The approval being asked about belongs to the same hand of the election machinery that keeps the voters' list and the result, so the laughter hides the real question: which office will produce the 80% figure?
